query: select jsonb_build_object('jobs',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(j),'[]'::jsonb) from (select jobid,jobname,schedule,active from cron.job order by jobid limit 20) j),'vault_names',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(v),'[]'::jsonb) from (select name from vault.secrets order by name limit 30) v),'extensions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(e),'[]'::jsonb) from (select name,installed_version from pg_available_extensions where name in ('pg_cron','pg_net','supabase_vault','pg_stat_statements','pgtap') limit 10) e)) as inventory limit 1
